prices_note: No PP point prices posted yet for this slate. Fair prices are shown; book prices appear after the morning odds pull.

notes: Features use only games before each game date; calibration is refit weekly on earlier weeks only.
No unit (PP1/PP2), goalie, line or game-total inputs in the backtest: those exist only for the live slate.
Book prices are the Book A 1+ price (the one book with full-season history); final pre-game price is a harder bar than the opener.
One-sided price includes the book's margin; book-implied Brier is shown without removing it.

High-end fix: chances above 38% are compressed (40% of the excess kept), shown chance never exceeds 40%, and Strong is blocked when the uncompressed chance is 45%+, the range where this season's rows hit only about 31%. The 38%/40%/45% settings were set by hand after seeing this season, so the improvement shown is partly in-sample.

method: Team PP chances: league average x how often the team draws penalties x how often the opponent takes them (shrunk to league).
Player share: his recent share of team PP time (weighted to the last ~4 games) plus season share; PP1/PP2 from the last game's units.
Player rate: PP points per 60, pulled toward the league rate for his role until he has enough PP minutes.
Opponent penalty kill: PP goals allowed per PK minute vs league. Posted game total nudges the rate.

Chance of 1+ PP point = 1 - e^-expected PP points, calibrated on this season's games; chances above 38% are compressed and capped at 40% because the top end ran hot in testing. Edge = chance x decimal price - 1.

Strong: edge 5%+ and 30%+ chance with lineup and goalie confirmed, and not above the tested range (45%+ before compression). Lean: positive edge. Holds and goalie-pending rows are never Strong. This board never marks Highlighted plays.
Graded from official game PP points; a player who does not play is void.
